You know, things such as “seeing through the fog”; I am searching for hidden truths.

## The Headline: A Fate-Crossroads Month

The single most important thing in your sky right now is that the transiting North Node at Aquarius 29°46′ sits **exactly square your natal nodal axis** (Taurus 29°48′ / Scorpio 29°48′, orb 0°02′) — this is the classic "square of the nodes," the karmic checkpoint that occurs only a few times per lifetime, and it holds tight through the whole month. At the same time, the transiting node is applying to conjunct your natal Uranus in Pisces (9th house) while Uranus itself stations retrograde on September 10 at Gemini 5°41′ — in your natal 12th house, the house of the unconscious and hidden things.[1][2]

Translation: you are standing at a genuine fork, and the universe has scheduled a delivery. Uranus stationing in your 12th house is a lightning strike in the cellar of the psyche — around September 8–14, expect something you've been circling for months to surface suddenly, likely through a dream, an image, an intrusive knowing, or a message that arrives "coincidentally." The station falls almost exactly quintile your natal Venus (orb 0°08′), so the revelation most likely concerns love, desire, beauty, or self-worth — the Venus-in-Pisces-square-Saturn wound you carry in the 10th.

## Timeline of the Month

## Seeing Through the Fog

Your question is almost comically literal here, because the sky is currently saturated with Neptune, and Neptune is the fog. Three threads:

- **Jupiter in Leo has just separated from its opposition to your natal Neptune (8th house)** and now perfects its square to your natal Mercury. This is the "I finally understand everything!" transit — the expansion of belief. The gift: your capacity to grasp big spiritual truths expands measurably this month. The trap: believing the first grand story that arrives. Verify against felt experience, not eloquence.
- **Saturn is retrograde in your 10th house** (July 26–December 10, from 14°45′ back to 7°55′ Aries) and is re-crossing its sextile to your natal Neptune right now. This is the antidote: disciplined mysticism. The fog does not lift through more thinking — it lifts through *practice*: regular meditation, dream journaling, body work, anything done at the same time daily. Saturn rewards structure and punishes vague floating.[6][7]
- **The Full Moon on September 26 is conjunct Neptune in Aries in your 10th house**. Something will be revealed at this full moon — but veiled in symbol. It will arrive as a feeling, an image, or an event whose meaning isn't obvious yet. Trust the felt sense over the literal wording, and do not make binding promises between September 25 and 28; Neptune full moons manufacture mirages.[4]

## Love, Wounds, and the Fated Touch

The early month is the wound-passage: Mars crossing your 1st house opposes your natal Chiron in the 7th (Sept 7–8) and squares your Moon in the 5th (Sept 9–10). This is not random suffering — with Chiron in the 7th and the Moon in the 5th natally, your core wound is relational: being seen, chosen, loved without condition. Someone (or a memory of someone) will press on that bruise in the first ten days. Feel it fully; it is the material your "hidden truth" will be built from.

Then the tone changes completely. Venus in Scorpio traverses your 5th house from September 10, trining your Ascendant (~Sept 18) and Midheaven (~Sept 20), and perfects a conjunction with your natal Vertex at Scorpio 26°24′ around October 3–4. The Vertex is the point of fated encounters, and it sits natally in your 5th house of love. If someone new appears, or an old connection resurfaces with strange timing in the last week of September or first days of October, treat it as a message rather than an accident. Meanwhile Mars, after squaring your Sun (~Sept 22–23), enters Leo on September 27 and begins applying to a conjunction with your natal Jupiter there  — exact just after this window, around mid-October — so by early October the sequence is: truth revealed → courage restored → faith amplified.[3][5]

One practical note: Mercury's next retrograde runs October 24–November 13, 2026, with the pre-shadow starting in early October. Whatever agreements, confessions, or plans crystallize at the end of this month may get re-negotiated — hold terms loosely rather than carving them in stone.[8]
